```cypher
MATCH (d:Dispatch)-[:RESOLVES]->(c:Case)-[:ABOUT]->(a:Asset)-[:IS_A]->(p:Product)
MATCH (d)-[u:USED]->(part:Part)
WITH p.family AS family,
     part.part_number AS part_number,
     SUM(u.quantity) AS total_qty
ORDER BY family, total_qty DESC, part_number
WITH family,
     collect({part_number: part_number, total_qty: total_qty}) AS ranked_parts
WHERE size(ranked_parts) > 0
RETURN family,
       ranked_parts[0].part_number AS part_number,
       ranked_parts[0].total_qty   AS total_quantity
```
